story_title: Lina and Adams Play Hide and Seek
title: Lina and Adams Play Hide and Seek 🙈 | Learn Position Words in English for Kids | Moon Tales Kids
description:
Where is Milo the cat? Play hide and seek with Lina, Adams and Milo at home and in the garden! 🙈🐱🏡
In this English story for kids, children learn 8 new words: hide, under, behind, inside, found, near, between and on. Listen, repeat, and learn English with Lina, Adams and Milo the cat.

📚 New words in this story:
🙈 hide — يختبئ / تخبّى — se cacher
⬇️ under — تحت — sous
🚪 behind — وراء / خلف — derrière
📦 inside — داخل / فالداخل — dedans / à l'intérieur
🎉 found — وجدنا / لقيناه — trouvé
🌼 near — قريب من — près de
↔️ between — بين — entre
🍽️ on — على / فوق — sur

👨‍👩‍👧 For parents: hide a toy at home and give clues in English: "under the table", "behind the door". Pause after each new word and say it out loud. Perfect for ages 3 to 8 and for children learning English as a second language.

🇲🇦 قصة باللغة الإنجليزية للأطفال لتعلم كلمات المكان: تحت، وراء، داخل، بين.
🇫🇷 Une histoire en anglais pour enfants pour apprendre les mots de position : sous, derrière, dedans, entre.

lines.text: It is a quiet Saturday morning. Lina and Adams are in the bedroom.
Milo the cat is stretching. Meow!
Let's play a game. Let's play hide and seek!
Yes! Milo, you hide first. We will look for you.
When you hide, you go to a secret place, so nobody can see you.
Say it with me: hide!
Milo wiggles his tail. He is ready to hide.
Lina and Adams close their eyes.
One, two, three, four, five.
Six, seven, eight, nine, ten!
Pitter, patter. Milo runs away on his soft little paws.
Ready or not, here we come!
Lina and Adams open their eyes. Milo is gone!
Where is Milo? Let's look everywhere.
Adams gets down on his hands and knees.
Is Milo under the bed?
He looks under the bed. There is a ball under the bed. But no Milo!
Silly ball! Milo is not under the bed.
Under means below something. The ball is under the bed.
Can you say it? Under!
Let's look in the kitchen!
Lina and Adams tiptoe into the kitchen. Shh!
Maybe Milo is behind the door.
Lina peeks behind the kitchen door. Nobody is there.
Maybe he is behind the table!
Behind means at the back of something, where it is hard to see.
Say it with me: behind!
Then they hear a tiny sound. Meow!
There is a big box on the kitchen floor. The box is moving!
Wiggle, wiggle! What is in the box?
Adams slowly opens the box. Two green eyes look up at him.
Milo is inside the box!
Inside means in the middle of something, like a box or a bag.
Can you say it? Inside!
Milo jumps out of the box. Meow, meow!
We found you, Milo! We found you!
Lina gives Milo a gentle pat. Milo purrs. Purr, purr.
Milo, you are very good at hiding!
When you look for something and then you see it, you say: I found it!
Say it with me: found!
Now it is our turn to hide. Milo, you look for us!
Milo sits and waits. He is a very clever cat.
Lina and Adams run into the sunny garden.
I will hide near the flowers.
Adams crouches down near the pretty pink flowers.
Near means close to something. Adams is near the flowers.
Can you say it? Near!
A butterfly lands on his nose. Adams tries not to giggle!
Sniff, sniff. Milo finds Adams very quickly. Meow!
Now, where is Lina?
Lina is hiding between the bike and the big tree.
Shh. Nobody can see me here.
Between means in the middle of two things.
Lina is between the bike and the tree.
Say it with me: between!
I am a very good hider!
Adams and Milo look and look. But they cannot find Lina.
Lina, where are you? I can't find you.
Adams feels a little worried. Lina is hiding for a long time.
Milo, can you help me? Let's look together.
Milo puts his nose to the grass. Sniff, sniff, sniff.
Milo walks to the bike, and stops. Meow!
Good job, Milo! We are a team!
Peekaboo! We found you, Lina!
Hooray! You found me! Milo is a super helper.
I was a little worried, Lina.
I am sorry, Adams. Next time, I will give you a clue.
Lina gives Adams a big hug. Friends always take care of each other.
Milo rubs his head on their legs. Purr, purr.
Hide and seek is more fun when we play together!
After the game, everyone is hungry.
Look! The sandwiches are on the table.
And the cups of milk are on the table too. Yummy!
On means on the top of something. The sandwich is on the table.
Can you say it? On!
Milo is not on the table. Good cat, Milo!
He waits nicely for his own little snack.
Later, Lina and Adams rest in the bedroom.
Today we played hide and seek. We looked under the bed and behind the door.
Milo was inside the box! And we found him!
I was near the flowers. No, that was you! I was between the bike and the tree!
Lina and Adams laugh and laugh.
And where is Milo now? He is on the bed, fast asleep. Shh!
Bye-bye, friends! Let's play again soon!
